title: Data Analysis Facade
instructions: Implement `DataAnalysisProcessor` in `data/processor.py` as a facade over the four analysis services. Inject them through the constructor (same order as `DataAnalysisManager`) and make `process(...)` collect, preprocess, analyse and visualise, returning the `AnalysisResult`. The manager and services are provided.

evidence.label: DataAnalysisManager exposes none of the four services
Pipeline runs collect, preprocess, analyse, visualise in order
Each stage's output feeds the next stage
Params, options and config are forwarded untouched
Returns the AnalysisResult from the algorithm service
A failing stage stops the pipeline and propagates
Works end to end with the default services
